meta.title: Token status bar
meta.description: Full-width bar at the bottom of the window: tokens spent in the open conversation (or across the whole process) split by peak and off-peak tariff and by prompt-cache hit or miss, output tokens, and the estimated cost in USD and CNY — priced by the plan of the model the session runs, with the model named in the bar and a red dot during peak hours. Settings list the models this Harness actually routes to; each model carries its own peak hours, USD→CNY rate and prices, so one model can be discounted at night while another keeps one price. A model priced at zero is counted in tokens only, and a model without peak hours loses the off-peak half of the bar. Autofill and a link to the published DeepSeek price list appear for DeepSeek models only. The interface follows the Harness language or can be pinned to English or Russian.
